items.title: Google Search Upgraded with Gemini 4 Hydrogen for Enhanced Capabilities
items.summary: Google announces a significant upgrade to its Search product, integrating the advanced Gemini 4 Hydrogen model to deliver more powerful and intelligent search results.

items.title: AI Claims Solution to Riemann Hypothesis, Alongside Human Breakthrough
items.summary: An AI system has reportedly claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, coinciding with a human researcher also announcing a potential breakthrough, highlighting AI's growing capabilities in complex mathematics.

items.title: Google Introduces Gemini Decisions API for Fast, Calibrated Multimodal Decisions
items.summary: Google launches the Gemini Decisions API, offering developers a new tool for making rapid and accurate multimodal decisions, expanding the practical applications of AI.

items.title: Daniel Ek Backs AI Researcher's Fusion Power Startup
items.summary: Spotify CEO Daniel Ek invests in an AI researcher's new startup focused on fusion power, signaling a significant venture capital interest in AI-driven energy solutions.

items.title: The Sleep Framework: A New Approach for LLMs to Retain Knowledge in Continual Learning
items.summary: Google Research introduces 'The Sleep Framework,' a novel method designed to enable large language models to better retain knowledge and prevent catastrophic forgetting during continual learning processes.

items.title: OpenAI Introduces MedChemBench to Aid Drug Discovery
items.summary: OpenAI unveils MedChemBench, a new initiative aimed at leveraging AI to help scientists more efficiently identify promising drug candidates, accelerating pharmaceutical research.

items.title: Hebbia Improves Financial Research with OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: Financial research firm Hebbia reports significant advancements in its operations by integrating OpenAI's latest large language model, GPT-6 Astra, demonstrating real-world enterprise application of cutting-edge AI.

items.title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied AI in Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: Researchers introduce Mind2Act World, a new diagnostic benchmark designed to evaluate embodied AI's ability to integrate mind, physical action, and their composition in complex robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: Probing 'Conscious' Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
items.summary: New research explores the concept of 'consciousness' in Vision-Language Models by investigating selective access and global workspace mechanisms, shedding light on how these models process and integrate information.

items.title: WeMM-Video: Advancing Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
items.summary: WeMM-Video pushes the boundaries of open-source AI, offering a new framework for comprehensive omni-modal video understanding that integrates various data types for richer analysis.

items.title: Agentic Engineering of Smart Home Energy System with Antigravity and Gemini 4
items.summary: A new project demonstrates the use of agentic engineering with Antigravity and Gemini 4 to create an intelligent smart home energy system, showcasing practical AI applications for energy management.

items.title: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
items.summary: Coda-DaVinci introduces an innovative Code2Video approach, fundamentally reimagining how video content can be generated through programmatic instructions, offering new creative possibilities.

items.title: Posterior Matching Distillation for Enhanced Model Training
items.summary: A new research paper introduces Posterior Matching Distillation, a technique aimed at improving the efficiency and performance of model training by aligning posterior distributions.

items.title: Depth Pro 2: Achieving Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
items.summary: Depth Pro 2 presents advancements in monocular depth estimation, delivering sharper and more temporally consistent metric depth maps from a single camera input, crucial for robotics and AR.

items.title: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
items.summary: This research proposes a novel method for 3D Gaussian segmentation using volumetric supervision, addressing challenges where traditional mask-based approaches fall short in complex 3D environments.
